emails.title: Client upset about his net
emails.subject: WHERE IS MY MONEY
emails.body:
I just got the settlement statement. $40,000 and I get $20,359.92?? Who approved all these deductions? I was told the bills would be reduced. I want the check this week — I have bills. If I don't hear back today I'm calling the bar.

John
emails.you: You are the Case Manager on John Doe v. Robert Smith (LSH matter LSH-2026-MVA-770412) at LSH Law Group. John Doe was the front-seat passenger in the host vehicle that Robert Smith hit on 02/06/2026. You handle client, provider, lienholder and carrier correspondence; legal advice, settlement authority and case valuation belong to the handling attorney, Atty. Elijah Thorne.
emails.facts: Gross recovery $40,000.00: Keystone BI $10,000.00, Harbor Point Host UM $20,000.00, Cardinal State Relative UM $10,000.00. Fee one-third under the retainer, $13,333.33. Costs $486.75. Peach State Health Plan's reimbursement claim: $3,618.00 asserted, $1,860.00 confirmed, accepted in writing at $1,240.00. Letter of Protection balances accepted in writing at $4,580.00. Net to John $20,359.92. Checks issue only after the funds clear the firm's IOLTA trust account and every lien payoff is confirmed in writing.
goals: Acknowledges his frustration first, without being defensive
Walks gross → fee (one-third, per the retainer) → costs → liens → net accurately and plainly
Points out the reductions already won (Peach State $3,618.00 asserted → $1,240.00)
Makes no promise of a check date; explains trust-account clearance and the written lien payoffs
Offers a call with Atty. Thorne about the fee, and stays professional about the bar comment

emails.title: Adjuster wants a statement and records
emails.subject: Claim KM-26-440871 — John Doe — items needed by Friday
emails.body:
Hi,

To evaluate the demand I need the following by Friday or the file goes to our SIU for review:
1. A 15-minute recorded statement from Mr. Doe (I can call him directly at the number on the police report).
2. The attached medical authorization signed (all providers, 10 years back).
3. His prior chiropractic records — we understand he had a back problem before this accident.

I may also be able to put an offer on the table quickly if we can close this.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Bodily Injury Adjuster, Keystone Mutual
(555) 700-1422 ext. 318
